integrity: The six-dimensional integral Frobenius lattice is determined from the Petersen dual graph. Its seven change-of-basis certificates have integer determinant ±1; a standalone standard-library exact verifier exhausts all 120 S5 cases. Scientific prior work is explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the canonical reduced stable ten-line boundary over finite fields, not the full Picard component group, smooth Wiman–Edge pencil members, other degenerations or the ambient surface zeta function. Historical priority of the seven integral torus decompositions is qualified by possible earlier unindexed calculations. Independent scientific auditing has not been performed.
title: Integral Frobenius types of the genus-six Petersen boundary on quintic del Pezzo surfaces
